digest.component_or_area: LLM completion orchestration and recovery modules
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py each hit the CI module-size cap (800 and 799 LOC respectively), blocking any further edits without refactoring

completion.py contains four distinct concerns: operation orchestration, deterministic child-closure gate, epic-close bug-screen layer, and verdict reconciliation; completion_recovery.py contains three: criteria surface/bounds/coverage contract, failure taxonomy, and recovery orchestration

decomposition must extract along existing call-graph seams into new modules (completion_child_gate, completion_reconcile, completion_criteria, completion_failures) while keeping stable public seams via re-exports from original modules
all moved symbols must remain patchable at their original dotted paths via facade re-exports, and tests must only update import paths and monkeypatch targets with zero assertion changes
final module sizes must be in range 200-500 LOC with no module exceeding 700 and lint/typecheck passing
